scripts.build:preview: for e in preview proto-follow proto-order proto-day proto-pixel proto-parts; do PREVIEW_ENTRY=$e vite build --mode preview-page && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/make-preview.ts $e || exit 1; done
scripts.test: vitest run tests/game.test.ts tests/persistence.test.ts tests/recovery-export.test.ts tests/account-sync.test.ts tests/account-auth.test.ts tests/account-writer.test.ts tests/account-lifecycle.test.ts tests/account-boot.test.ts tests/release-config.test.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:release: npm run build:release && cap sync android
scripts.android:reset: rm -rf android && cap add android && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync:release: npm run build:release && cap sync ios
